title: Reopen, supersession and stale-state invalidation
summary: Legal meaning is revisioned. Reopening an accepted answer or superseding a proposition invalidates everything that depended on the old interpretation. Compile handoffs are detached revision-bound snapshots and cannot silently track a live mutable session.
invariants: Reopening a question makes dependent propositions and proposition tests stale.
Superseded propositions remain audit history but are excluded from the active compile snapshot.
An already-issued handoff is rejected as stale after the authoring revision changes.
New proposition tests cannot be created against retired/superseded propositions.
Self-supersession and equivalent lifecycle shortcuts fail closed.

provenance.claim: Legal Interrogation dev5 implements clause interrogation, proposition challenge, lifecycle invalidation and a real Intention Service dev11 discovery adapter.
